title: Emergency Desalination
description: Explains why seawater is dangerous to drink and how to build solar, box, and cone stills, distill over a stove or fire, and dig a beach well. Compares manual, solar, and reverse-osmosis desalinators, with realistic output rates, how to test results, and when to look for other water.
shortDescription: Solar stills, distillation, and beach wells to make seawater drinkable
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
